## Air temperature chart. July 2026.

- Data source. Weather information received from the weather station Central Park (New York, USA). Current location of the weather station: latitude 40.7789, longitude -73.9692, height above sea level 40 m.
- Explanations for calculating daily mean values. The values of air temperature and precipitation in the table are given for the meteorological day, which starts in New York City at 5 h. UTC (0 h. local time).
- Explanations to the chart. Current minimum, average, and maximum air temperature in New York City are represented on the chart by solid lines of blue, green, and red colors. Normal values are shown as solid thin lines. The absolute highs and lows of temperature for each day are indicated by bold red and blue dots.
- Explanations for daily and monthly records. Temperature records for each day are defined as the lowest and highest values for a range of daily resolution data. For monitoring of weather in New York City, daily data is taken for the period 1869-2026 years. Monthly weather records are determined based on a number of monthly resolution data. Monthly data is taken for the period 1821-2026 years - air temperature, 1869-2026 years - precipitation.
